On the other hand, her apartment is clean.

examples.trans: Get out of here quickly and go work!

examples.text: Беги отсюда, маленький придурок, стой!
examples.trans: Run away from here, little fool, stop!

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда.
examples.trans: I'll get out of here.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: Всё, мама, пока, мне пора работать.
examples.trans: Alright, Mom, bye, it is time for me to work.

examples.text: Я постоянно с людьми работаю.
examples.trans: I work with people all the time.

examples.text: Быстро пошли вон отсюда работать!
examples.trans: Get out of here quickly and go work!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'it's time', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мы ведь не спали до сих пор.
examples.trans: After all, we still have not slept together.

examples.text: Ты в паспорт мой не смотри.
examples.trans: Do not look at my passport.

examples.text: Давай поспорим с тобой на зарплату!
examples.trans: Let us bet a month's salary on it!

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'загрузить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to reboot, reset'.

examples.text: Нам пора перезагрузить наши отношения.
examples.trans: It is time for us to reset our relationship.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и перезагрузить вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to reboot on time.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'our', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Наш Лёва запал на дочку шефа.
examples.trans: Our Lyova has fallen for the Chef's daughter.

examples.text: Если бы хотел, сразу бы нашёл.
examples.trans: If I wanted one, I would find one right away.

examples.text: Ну что, где будет наше свидание?
examples.trans: So, where is our date going to be?

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ношение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'relationship' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мне просто не нужны сейчас отношения.
examples.trans: I simply do not need a relationship right now.

examples.text: Мне не нужны сейчас отношения.
examples.trans: I do not need a relationship right now.

examples.text: Нам пора перезагрузить наши отношения.
examples.trans: It is time for us to reset our relationship.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, я сейчас.
examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.

examples.text: Подождите минуту.
examples.trans: Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian cardinal or ordinal numeral meaning 'one', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: На работу буду приходить на час позже.
examples.trans: I will come to work an hour later.

examples.text: Хорошо, договорились, приходи на час позже.
examples.trans: Alright, it is a deal, come an hour later.

examples.text: Погоди, ты что, мне не веришь?
examples.trans: Wait, do you not believe me?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'екунда'). Common feminine noun meaning 'second' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Шеф, можно к вам на секунду?
examples.trans: Chef, may I speak with you for a second?

examples.text: Подожди одну секунду, вот, возьми.
examples.trans: Wait one second, here, take this.

examples.text: Секунду. Сейчас я позвоню.
examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'take', paired with 'брать'.

examples.text: Дима, я не могу их взять.
examples.trans: Dima, I cannot take them right now.

examples.text: Возьмите на работу Галилея.
examples.trans: Go and hire Galileo.

examples.text: Возьми деньги.
examples.trans: Take the money.
